{{Top|leg}}
'''Kuat Traffic Control''' was responsible for coordinating [[Starship/Legends|starship]] entering and exiting the [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat system]] and the [[Inner Kuat Transfer Zone]]. In addition, Kuat Traffic Control established bases in a number of staging [[Star system/Legends|systems]] where incoming and outgoing traffic passed through.
